summary.text: Get a referral from a CHAS clinic or polyclinic. CHAS clinic referrals require a PG, MG or CHAS card.

details.heading: Using a CHAS clinic
details.body: You will need to be a PG, MG or CHAS cardholder to obtain a subsidised SOC referral from a CHAS clinic.

details.heading: Using a polyclinic
details.body: A polyclinic can also provide a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs.

steps.name: Choose where to go
steps.text: Go to either a CHAS clinic or a polyclinic to get the referral.

steps.name: Check your card
steps.text: If you use a CHAS clinic, make sure you are a PG, MG or CHAS cardholder.

steps.name: Ask for the referral
steps.text: Ask the CHAS clinic or polyclinic for a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs.

example_phrasings: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?
Where can I get a subsidised SOC referral?
Can a CHAS clinic or polyclinic refer me for subsidised care?

sources.page_title: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?

quotes.text: A referral for subsidised care at public SOCs can be obtained from either CHAS clinics or polyclinics.
Do note that you will need to be a PG/MG/CHAS cardholder to obtain subsidised SOC referrals from CHAS clinics.
